name: Work & Business
description: Product ideas, strategy, marketing, sales, operations, customer work, and professional decisions.

tree.name: Work
tree.description: Professional, product, business, marketing, sales, and operations material.

profile.summary: Use when the saved material is mainly about work decisions, product direction, business context, marketing, sales, customers, or operations. Do not use for technical implementation unless the business decision is primary.

children.name: Product Ideas
children.description: Product concepts, feature ideas, user problems, MVPs, prioritization, and product discovery.

profile.summary: Use for product concepts and product management: feature ideas, user problems, MVPs, prioritization, discovery, product requirements, and user impact.
negative_examples: Raw personal idea with no product context.

children.name: Strategy & Market
children.description: Markets, competitors, positioning, business models, strategic bets, and long-term choices.

profile.summary: Use for strategic business material: markets, competitors, positioning, business models, segments, long-term choices, and trade-offs.

children.name: Marketing & Content
children.description: Positioning, messaging, channels, campaigns, content ideas, audience work, and creator distribution.

profile.summary: Use for marketing and content distribution: positioning, messaging, audience, channels, campaigns, content ideas, copywriting, and demand generation.

children.name: Sales & Customers
children.description: Customer calls, CRM, deals, objections, follow-ups, customer development, and sales process.

profile.summary: Use for sales and customer interaction: calls, CRM notes, objections, follow-ups, deals, customer development, and sales process.
